prompt:
The section file sections/video-section.liquid embeds a YouTube or Vimeo video. Its markup reads section.settings.heading, section.settings.video_url (expects a video_url setting object with .type and .id), section.settings.cover_image, section.settings.autoplay and section.settings.aspect_ratio. The current schema declares the video as a plain url setting, lacks the aspect ratio select, and has no preset. Do not change any markup. Only replace the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block at the end of the file so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array entries in this order:

Top level:
- "name": "Video"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "video-section"
- "settings": an array of five settings:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Watch the story"
  2. type "video_url", id "video_url", label "Video URL", accept ["youtube", "vimeo"] (in that order); no default
  3. type "image_picker", id "cover_image", label "Cover image"; no default
  4. type "checkbox", id "autoplay", label "Autoplay video", default false (JSON boolean)
  5. type "select", id "aspect_ratio", label "Aspect ratio", options (in this order): {"value": "16-9", "label": "16:9"}, {"value": "4-3", "label": "4:3"}, {"value": "1-1", "label": "Square"}; default "16-9"
- "presets": an array with one preset: {"name": "Video"} (no other keys)

There are no blocks: do not include a "blocks" key or any other key not listed. Change only sections/video-section.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
